content: Did-you-mean latency: brute-force per-word edit distance over index vocabulary is O(|V|*L^2) - too slow for serving path at real vocab sizes (measured 315ms avg/1.2s max on 20GB index). SymSpell delete-index: 0.033ms/word at edit distance 2, 2-3 orders faster than BK-tree; costs precomputed memory-resident delete dictionary (~L^2/2 keys per term for k=2; tens of millions of keys for 1M-term vocab) built once at startup from the term dictionary. Relevancy trap from lnx: general-dictionary correction suggests words NOT in the index ('trumen show'->'true man show' segmentation instead of index term 'truman show') - must constrain suggestions to index vocabulary (FTS5 term dictionary / fts5vocab), verify candidates with exact distance. 10-15% of queries contain misspellings. Interactive budget: aim <100ms. Alternative: Levenshtein automaton over trie/FST of vocabulary. Sources: blog.cf8.gg lnx SymSpell 2021, seekstorm SymSpell vs BK-tree, wolfgarbe/SymSpell, mercemay edit-distance candidate generation 2025.
